title: Data Export Approval Policy
text: Data export requires manager approval for confidential datasets. Public datasets may be exported without legal review when the data classification registry marks the dataset as public. Exports containing personal data require privacy counsel review and audit logging.

title: Vendor Access Review Policy
text: Vendor access requires legal review before onboarding production tenants. Sandbox tenants may use a short-form review if access is read-only and expires within seven days. All vendor access decisions require a source reference and owner approval.

title: Record Retention Policy
text: Customer support records are retained for two years unless a legal hold applies. Security audit records are retained for five years. Deletion requests must be reviewed against the active legal hold registry before removal.

title: Incident Notification Policy
text: Security incidents involving regulated customer data require notification review within 72 hours. Low-severity incidents without customer data are tracked internally and do not trigger external notice. The incident owner must preserve evidence.

title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Policy
text: Cross-border transfer of restricted customer data requires privacy counsel approval and a transfer impact assessment. Transfers of anonymized operational metrics are permitted when no personal data or confidential business data is included.
